content.title: Bloodhounds Season 2 K-Drama Release Date, Trailer and Cast
content.text: Bloodhounds is Back for Round TwoGet a taste of the next-level action in the official trailer for the Korean boxing drama’s new season.It’s time to step back into the ring: The second season of Bloodhounds is available to stream on Netflix now.The Korean boxing revenge saga came out swinging in 2023, blending bare-knuckle action with a story of unlikely heroics, as two prizefighters take down a ruthless loan shark operation. The new season picks up three years later with a bigger stage and even higher stakes as it moves into the brutal world of an underground international boxing league.What is Bloodhounds Season 2 about?Woo Do-hwan and Lee Sang-yi return as Gun-woo and Woo-jin, a pair of fighters hardened by the battles they’ve fought together. Having taken down the loan sharks, Gun-woo is more motivated than ever to pursue his dream of becoming a boxing champion — with Woo-jin now fully in his corner as his coach and chosen family. But the duo face a menacing new foe who fights for money and power above all else: Baek-jeong (Jung Ji-hoon). Once again, Gun-woo and Woo-jin must fight to protect everything they hold dear.When is the release date?Bloodhounds Season 2 premiered on April 3, and is now streaming on Netflix.Who is in the Bloodhounds Season 2 cast?Woo Do-hwan as Kim Gun-wooLee Sang-yi as Hong Woo-jinJung Ji-hoon as Im Baek-jeongChoi Siwon as Hong Min-beomHwang Chan-sung as Yoon Tae-geomInternationalDramaSportsDeep DiveArticleShop BloodhoundsDiscover More Deep DiveDeep DiveA group of new college graduates must navigate a messy SoCal homecoming.By Olivia Harrison11:50 amDeep DiveRead with tissues nearby.By Brookie McIlvaine2:30 amDeep DiveFind out everything you need to know about the new season.
